name: auth-failure
description: A revoked or mistyped API token. Kandji answers 401 on the device list; the run must end with the error printed and zero assets, not an abort, and no detail request may be attempted. 401 is not in get_json's retryable status list, so exactly one request is made.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.
